charm.definition:
n. something believed to bring good luck
n. (physics) one of the six flavors of quark
v. control by magic spells, as by practicing witchcraft
v. protect through supernatural powers or charms
charm.translation:
n. 吸引力, 魔力, 符咒
vt. 迷住, 使陶醉, 行魔法
vi. 用符咒, 有魅力

charm offensive.translation: n. （讨好对手等的）魅力攻势

charm price.translation: [经] 有吸引力的价格, 动人价格

charm sth out of sb.translation: 从某人那里诱出,哄走某人某物

charmant.translation: n. 魅力日本大发（汽车公司名）；夏蒙（眼睛品牌名）

charme.translation: 港丽餐厅（北京西单）；查尔梅（西班牙语姓名）；（法）魅力

charmed.definition:
v attract; cause to be enamored
v control by magic spells, as by practicing witchcraft
v protect through supernatural powers or charms
v induce into action by using one's charm
s strongly attracted
s filled with wonder and delight

charmer.definition: n. a person who charms others (usually by personal attractiveness)
charmer.translation: n. 巫士, 可爱的人

charmers.definition:
n. someone with an assured and ingratiating manner
n. a person who charms others (usually by personal attractiveness)
charmers.translation: n. 对异性有吸引力的人( charmer的复数形式 )

charming.definition:
s. pleasing or delighting
s. possessing or using or characteristic of or appropriate to supernatural powers
charming.translation: a. 迷人的, 有吸引力的

charmless.translation: a. 无魅力的, 无吸引力的, 不美的

charmonium.translation: [单复同]n.[核](被认为由一对粲夸克-反夸克构成的)粲素

charms.definition:
n attractiveness that interests or pleases or stimulates
n a verbal formula believed to have magical force
n something believed to bring good luck
n (physics) one of the six flavors of quark
v attract; cause to be enamored
v control by magic spells, as by practicing witchcraft
v protect through supernatural powers or charms
v induce into action by using one's charm
charms.translation: n. 吸引力；符咒；护身符（charm的复数形式）
